evidence.detail: Exact v308 builds root widget 47500 and preserves the literal title 'Official SpawnPK Item Library'.

The class owns selected-item guide state, ITEM_GUIDE_SELECTED_* keys, wiki/item resources, category and description rendering, item search controls, and the exact 'Selected Item Guide Title Text' placeholder.

The same interface builds 'View equipment bonuses' plus attack/defence bonus rows such as Stab, Slash, Crush, Magic and Range, proving the item-library scope extends into the selected item's guide/stat presentation.
Exact controls include 'Search by item' and '<img=39> Search for an item', with the search field/button living inside the same 47500/478xx widget family.

proposals.note: Name follows the exact visible 'Official SpawnPK Item Library' title and the complete item-guide/search/stat widget responsibility.
